verdict.rationale: Stagehand is documented as an SDK (TypeScript/Python/Go) that runs in the developer's own process. Remote browsers can come from Browserbase, but no evidence shows a hosted HTTP endpoint where an agent submits a natural-language task and gets results by polling or webhook. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all paths, and the server-side caching and MCP/stdio integrations are adjacent features, not a hosted task-submission API.
